cover.learning_purpose: Identify the lesson and its central decision at a glance.
cover.title: SE10 · Databases · cover
cover.caption: Identify the lesson and its central decision at a glance. Model relationships and enforce invariants in persistent storage.
cover.alt_text: Learner and course tabs fit together in one record drawer, representing related data protected by a unique enrollment constraint.
cover.extended_description:
Model relationships and enforce invariants in persistent storage.

An enrollment table references learner and course IDs and has a unique learner/course pair. Two concurrent enrollment requests then cannot create duplicate enrollment records even if both passed an earlier UI check.

Enforce uniqueness in the database; two requests can both pass an earlier UI check.
cover.generation_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. BTG AI educational lesson cover, high-resolution 16:9. One dominant editorial visual metaphor, one subtle secondary context element, no explanatory diagram. Sophisticated matte cut-paper illustration, indigo #141724 background, restrained cyan and violet, quiet warm neutrals, tactile paper, soft subtle depth. Essential subject grouped within the central 40% of the frame for square and 4:5 crops, generous empty border and title-safe upper margin. No text, letters, numerals, chart values, logos, robots, brains, neon or fictitious dashboards. Lesson Databases: model relationships and enforce invariants in persistent storage. Canonical example: learner/course enrollment references both IDs and enforces a unique pair against concurrent duplicate requests. Dominant metaphor: two keyed filing tabs joined into a single precisely fitted record drawer, while a duplicate tab rests outside the slot. Secondary element: two small blank index cards representing learner and course. The central tangible join and one-slot constraint should identify relational data. Not a database architecture diagram.
